headline: The Hub now writes a follow-up draft or a quick prep itself, in seconds. When an Apply cannot be confirmed it says so instead of asking you to press again, and a typed to-do is added once. Urgent, the plate and the live prep save keep out names of people who are off limits. If your prep edits cannot be read, say "repair my prep edits". After updating, say "update my hub" once and reload the Hub tab.
